subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Most of the passengers complained/ that the speed of the bus/ was usual fast.

options.text: that the speed of the bus

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. was usual fast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase **"was usual fast."**
 
• The word **"usual"** is an adjective and cannot modify the adverb **"fast."** Instead, the correct form should be the adverb **"usually."**
 
• The correct sentence should read: **"Most of the passengers complained that the speed of the bus was usually fast."**

Correct sentence: *Most of the passengers complained that the speed of the bus was usually fast.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjectives vs. Adverbs:**
 
 
• **Adjectives:** Describe nouns or pronouns (e.g., "usual speed").
 
• **Adverbs:** Modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs (e.g., "usually fast").
 
 
 
• It is important to choose the correct form based on the function of the word in the sentence to ensure grammatical accuracy.
